text: The **University of Maryland’s Global Forest Change (GFC) dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13)** detected the 2021 tree-cover loss. This dataset is the primary source for the observed event, reporting **81.3 hectares of loss** in that year. The detection was corroborated by the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset**, which confirmed that **98% of the event area was forested in 2020**, meeting the corroboration rule. The **MGAP National Forest Cartography (2021)** further classified the affected area as planted forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), but it did not independently detect the loss event. Thus, the **Hansen GFC dataset was the direct source** for the 2021 tree-cover loss observation.
